title: Missing work
summary: Source Editor dev8 candidate now includes Atomic File publication, argv-safe multi-word find/grep semantics and first lexical/source-aware reference navigation. Remaining priority work is independent qualification, stronger impact/call navigation, guarded ProposedChange/patch operations, direct ooRexx CLI UI binding, a Development Desk read/materialise adapter, and native NewShell worker/client/runtime integration.
tasks: Extend dev8 lexical references toward callers/callees/impact only where scanner/compiler evidence supports the stronger claim.
Complete independent r13196/native-provider qualification of the dev6 Atomic File integration (Rasen Falcon REQ-00000589), then seal/package only on PASS.
Guarded ProposedChange/patch object with base identity/hash precondition.
Direct ooRexx CLI UI binding to SourceDocument and SourceCompletionProvider.
Read/materialise adapter boundary for Development Desk / Semantic Source Store.
Integrate Source Editor capability into the native NewShell worker/client/runtime surface rather than maintaining a side CLI only.
